teacher_info.introduction:
My name is Dr. Rod Rogers. 

I am from the United States, but currently live and work in Guadalajara, Mexico. 

FOCUS 
I help you achieve your English learning goals as quickly and enjoyably as possible. I minimize the use of complex grammar lessons and focus on fun, understandable conversation without anxiety. I follow Stephen Krashen's "Comprehensible Input Theory of language learning"--"Language acquisition does not require extensive use of conscious grammatical rules, and does not require tedious drill....The best methods are therefore those that supply 'comprehensible input' in low anxiety situations, containing messages that students really want to hear." 

QUALIFICATIONS 
TEFL certifications in both General and Business English. I have been a life-long learner of languages. I have studied Portuguese, mastered biblical Greek and Hebrew, and currently am learning to speak Spanish. I have presented thousands of lessons and speeches all around the world. I have Bachelor's, Master's, and Doctor's degrees in Bible, Old Testament and Semitic Languages, and Communications. I am the published author of three books and one short fiction story. 


WHAT MAKES ME A SPECIAL TEACHER IS... 
* my sense of humor--we will always have fun! 
* my genuine concern to help you learn 
* my in-depth knowledge of the English language gained in earning two advanced degrees 
* my experience in writing and publishing several books 
* my 35 years of teaching experience in schools, in churches, and as a professional speaker 
* my understanding of how to learn a language

CLASS PROCEDURE
I have many back to back classes. So, in order to start each class on time, my policy is to provide a brief summary of our lesson 5 minutes before the class ends, and to close our connection 2 minutes early. This gives each student the maximum time possible.

pro_course_detail.title: General German for Beginners to Elementary (A1-A2)

Would you like to build up a strong foundation in German? Do you already know some basic expressions or are you starting to learn the language from scratch? Then this course is for you!

We will use an A1 or A2 level book series to learn vocabulary, practise speaking on a variety of everyday topics, and ease into grammar. Whether you aim to spend some time in a German-speaking country, learn something new, or one day speak German to family, friends, and loved ones, we will work to develop your ability to express yourself and understand spoken and written German for use in everyday life. 

Students will be assigned light homework exercises to review vocabulary and structures covered in class before the next lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: Lesestunde: German Reading and Writing (B1-C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
In order to improve your reading and writing skills we will practise different reading techniques and strategies and look at writing as a process. During our German lessons we will read an interesting text - at times aloud, at times individually - before completing exercises that will help to strengthen your understanding of the text and expand your vocabulary. You will learn how to avoid writing mistakes and how to successfully structure and edit your own writing so that is easily readable. 
 
Our aim in this course is not to seek perfection or mistake-free German, but rather to strive towards an understandable use of the language in speech and writing and deepen your joy of reading.
 
Um Ihre Lese- und Schreibfertigkeiten zu verbessern werden wir zusammen unterschiedliche Lesetechniken und -strategien üben und das Schreiben als Prozess betrachten. Während der Deutschstunde lesen wir mal vor, mal als Einzelarbeit, und erledigen Aufgaben, die Ihr Verständnis des Textes verfestigen und ihren Wortschatz erweitern sollen. Sie werden lernen wie man Schreibfehler vermeiden kann und einen gut lesbaren Text erfolgreich aufbaut und bearbeitet. 
 
Wir streben nicht nach Perfektion oder fehlerfreiem Deutsch, sondern nach einer verständlichen Sprache in Wort und Schrift und mehr Freude am Lesen.

pro_course_detail.title: Book Club: Reading and Writing in English (B1-C2)
pro_course_detail.description:
In this course you will improve your use of English by reading, discussing, and writing about thought-provoking essays, interviews, articles, and stories of various lengths and types. We will practise reading aloud and individually during our English lessons, although at times you may be asked to read a chapter or medium-length short story at home to prepare for our discussion in the next lesson. We will look at different strategies for using a text to learn new vocabulary, complete comprehension exercises in order to strengthen your understanding of key ideas in the text, and learn to structure and edit your own stories, essays and written responses.
 
Our aim in this course is not to seek perfection or mistake-free English, but rather to strive towards an effective use of the language in speech and writing and deepen your joy of reading.

pro_course_detail.title: Exploring the Canon: A Light Reading of English Classics (B1-C2)
pro_course_detail.description:

In this course we will read and discuss a handful of English-language texts that have served as the inspiration for art, poetry, drama, and film from their conception to the modern day. We will take a look at both historical and modern works, including plays, short stories, essays and longer works, some of which may be adapted for the modern reader. Although our discussions and activities will be loosely structured on key themes and elements of style in the texts, students are encouraged to bring their own discussion questions and ideas to class.

A modest, manageable amount of at-home reading may be assigned depending on the work we are covering. Students are advised to take their time with the material and wait to book the next lesson until they have completed the reading.

This class option is ideal for German learners at all levels who are:

+ preparing for an upcoming unit test/quiz in your German class at a (language) school or university
+ at risk of failing a German class and need additional support
+ self-learners with various questions about the language and/or would like structured practice on a specific grammatical topic

We can schedule a specialised one-time session or package deal in order to clarify, review, and practise using the grammatical structures and vocabulary that you find difficult. If you would like regularly-scheduled, personally customised lessons for a reason other than those mentioned above, please send me a message about what you would like to focus on specifically and we can see about developing the proper course of action to realise your language learning goals.

Students will be provided with digital learning materials for class and assigned homework exercises to review grammatical structures and concepts before the next lesson.
